title: How do factory handling requirements differ for superalloy bar and plate-coil furnaces?
summary: Two Suneng discussion drafts for the same superalloy tube-and-plate project propose a sloping-hearth bar-heating furnace and a bell-type plate/coil annealing furnace respectively. The first connects turnover feeding, internal rolling and push-out rollers; the second relies on an overhead crane for loading and bell movement. Site compatibility begins with these two different handling routes.
